title: flare/share/v1
description: The share, its latest version, the people it is granted to and the flares it responds to, or what a dry run checked.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

ShareOut.description: A share that `flare share` made or updated, or that a dry run checked.

checks.description: What a dry run checked, wrote and could not check; empty on a real run.

granted.description: The addresses that now hold a role on it; none after `--update` or a dry run.

id.description: The share's id; none on a dry run of a new share.

responds_to.description: The flares it responds to; none after `--update` or a dry run.

title.description: The share's title; none on a dry run of `--update`, which does not read the share.

version.description: The share's latest version; none on a dry run.
